config.model.pricingDescription: USD per million tokens. Leave blank to use models.dev reference prices, or enter your provider's rates. Unlisted prices remain unknown.
config.model.visionInputDescription: Declare the image types this model endpoint accepts; leave both lists empty to use the defaults.
config.model.visionInputMimeTypesHint: Type a shorthand such as png or jpg and press Enter, or add a common format below. Clearing the list restores the defaults.
config.model.visionInputMimeTypesEmpty: Not declared. The dashed tags above are the formats accepted by default.
config.model.visionInputAnimatedMimeType: Add only formats whose animated variants the endpoint explicitly supports. Empty sends static images only.
config.model.visionInputInvalidFormat: Enter an image format such as image/png or png
config.model.imageGeneration.title: Image generation
config.model.imageGeneration.hint: Declare the supported image protocol and editing capabilities. Uses this model’s provider connection.
